test: P2 Network Preload Ordering A/B Test
condition: Mobile Throttled (4x CPU slowdown, 1.6 Mbps download, 750 Kbps upload, 150ms latency)

VariantA.description: HTML head low-priority preloads (fetchpriority=low) with Logo.png as only high-priority preload

VariantB.description: Dynamic script injection from main.jsx after entry JS execution

reason: HTML head low-priority preloads enable the browser's preload scanner to discover 3D assets early and pipeline requests without blocking the high-priority logo or entry JS. Deferring preloads to main.jsx delays initial fetch by ~193 ms.
